text_block_list.text:
The front pack rounds the fourth corner!
They're
entering the final straight! Which
of them will
conquer the Kikuka Sho?!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhh!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Raaaah!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: (Hayahide... Her aura's incredible!)
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
The battle between BNW comes to a
head! And
the winner is... Winning
Ticket!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Tickezo! You were amazing!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
The BNW girls are the best! I couldn't
look away
for a single moment!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: Haha! Thank you!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to give you another great
race next
time!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, did you see that?! My fans were
all super
excited!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list:
That's what happens when you show them a
great race!

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Everyone got so fired up, I feel

overwhelmed myself!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
You know, it would never have been this
exciting
without Taishin and Hayahide!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I could feel my skin tingle from their
intensity!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that we'll have even more
awesome races
together!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hey, is my next race decided already? I
wanna
run with them again!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
If the fan nominations go our way, the
Arima
Kinen will be a strong contender,
but it's too
early to say that for sure.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
For now, a good target might be the
Osaka Hai,
often said to be the race that
decides the
greatest senior
medium-distance runner of the
spring
season.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There's a fair chance Нарита Таисин and
Biwa
Hayahide will enter as well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The Osaka Hai? Sure, I'm in!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll go full speed at the Osaka
Hai and
give my fans a great show!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит is pumped for her next
goal, the
Osaka Hai.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, two figures are quietly
watching her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
